competencies.name: Cardiac cycle
competencies.can: Order the phases of the cardiac cycle and state the pressure relationship that opens and closes the atrioventricular and semilunar valves in each phase.

competencies.name: Pressure volume loop
competencies.can: Label the four phases of a ventricular pressure volume loop and predict how the loop changes with increased preload, increased afterload, or increased contractility.

competencies.name: Heart sounds
competencies.can: Explain the origin of the first and second heart sounds and relate a murmur to valve stenosis or regurgitation by its timing.

competencies.name: Stroke volume and ejection fraction
competencies.can: Calculate stroke volume and ejection fraction from end diastolic and end systolic volumes and interpret a reduced ejection fraction.

competencies.name: Cardiac output
competencies.can: Calculate cardiac output and cardiac reserve and predict the effect of a change in heart rate or stroke volume on each.

competencies.name: Frank Starling relationship
competencies.can: State the Frank Starling law and explain how venous return and end diastolic volume determine the force of the next contraction.

competencies.name: Preload afterload and contractility
competencies.can: Distinguish preload, afterload, and contractility and predict how a change in each alters stroke volume.

competencies.name: Autonomic regulation of the heart
competencies.can: Explain how sympathetic and parasympathetic input alter heart rate and contractility at the receptor and second messenger level.

competencies.name: Heart sound and pulse correlation
competencies.can: Auscultate the heart sounds, locate the valve areas, and correlate the sounds with the pulse and with the cardiac cycle phases.
